# Grol Media

> Grol Media is a SaaS marketing agency based in Bulgaria, founded by Georgi Georgiev. We help B2B SaaS companies acquire, retain, and grow through Meta Ads, lifecycle email flows, and product-level growth advice - engineered to lower CAC and grow LTV. We work on a results-based model, starting most engagements before any retainer is billed.

## Services

- [Meta Ads built for SaaS](https://grolmedia.com/meta-ads-for-saas/): Full-funnel paid acquisition on Meta, built specifically for B2B SaaS products.
- [Email flows that compound](https://grolmedia.com/email-flows/): Lifecycle email systems covering onboarding, activation, re-engagement, and expansion.
- [Product-level advice](https://grolmedia.com/product-advice/): Session-based product and positioning advice to raise activation and lower churn.

## Pricing

- [Pricing plans](https://grolmedia.com/#pricing): Starter, Grower, Scaler, and custom plans - results-based to start.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://grolmedia.com/blog/): SaaS marketing guides on Meta Ads, funnels, activation, and growth.
